**Finding: compliant (NONCOMPETE)**

The agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Sparkling, which satisfies our preferred position:

- **§ 3 Restrictions on Use** is purely licence-scope conduct (no copying beyond backups, no sublicence/transfer/export, no reverse engineering, "not use the Work except as authorized herein") — nothing about the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build.
- **§ 2 Grant of License** is a non-exclusive licence; the AS400/Authorized Locations wording limits the licence footprint (with additional fees for other locations), not our freedom to source or develop alternatives.
- **§ 19** is a mutual employee non-solicitation (term plus one year) — a different rule category, and mutual, so not flagged here.
- **§§ 14, 16, 17, 20** contain no competitive restraint on us; searches for "compete/competing", "competitor/similar software", "develop/market/sell", exclusivity and field-of-use terms returned no hits.

No redline proposed. Note for the file: the clause is at preferred, not merely fallback, so there is nothing to trade here.
